arudha.exceptions: If the computed pada falls in the 1st or 7th from the house itself, take the 10th from the computed pada instead
arudha.method: For each house: count inclusively forward from the house to its lord's sign; count the same number forward from the lord — that sign is the pada
arudha.source: Jaimini Upadesa Sutras 1.1.30-32, as commonly transmitted

chara_dasha.antardasha: 12 equal sub-periods per mahadasha, counted from the dasha sign in the dasha's direction
chara_dasha.direction: 9th from Lagna odd -> forward (savya); even -> backward (apasavya)
variants: Some schools start from the 7th when Lagna is even (pada-krama)
Some count years from the lord to the sign with odd/even-lord direction
Some give 10 years when the lord is in the 7th from the sign
Some use Rahu/Ketu as co-lords of Aquarius/Scorpio (BPHS-based; not in the Jaimini sutras per the specialist literature)
chara_dasha.year_rule: Years = inclusive forward count from the sign to its lord, minus one; 12 years if the lord occupies the sign itself

karakas.note: Ties broken by full precision (minutes/seconds); some traditions drop tied planets — variant disclosed
karakas.rule: Sun..Saturn ordered by intra-sign longitude, descending

school_note: The Jaimini school is distinct from the Parashari system; its dashas, karakas and padas are never mixed silently with Parashari timing in this engine
sign_lords: per data/yogas.json (Mars rules Scorpio, Saturn rules Aquarius; no nodal co-lords)
source: Jaimini Upadesa Sutras ch. 1, as commonly transmitted; Chara year/direction rules cross-checked against the Jyotisha Bharati teaching notes and the Jaimini rashi-dasha literature
